name: Apache runtime smoke

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'apache2/**'
      - '.github/workflows/apache-runtime-smoke.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  apache-startup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        http2: [ 'false', 'true' ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Start Apache and PHP-FPM with the Compose mounts
        env:
          HTTP2: ${{ matrix.http2 }}
        run: |
          set -eux
          docker build --build-arg APACHE_INSTALL_HTTP2="$HTTP2" -t laradock-apache-smoke ./apache2
          mkdir -p /tmp/laradock-apache-www /tmp/laradock-apache-logs /tmp/laradock-apache-sites /tmp/laradock-apache-ssl
          echo apache-smoke > /tmp/laradock-apache-www/index.html
          echo "<?php echo 'php-smoke';" > /tmp/laradock-apache-www/smoke.php
          if [ "$HTTP2" = true ]; then
            cp apache2/sites/default.apache.ssl.example /tmp/laradock-apache-sites/default.conf
          else
            cp apache2/sites/default.apache.conf /tmp/laradock-apache-sites/default.conf
          fi
          docker network create laradock-apache-smoke
          trap 'docker logs apache-smoke || true; docker logs php-fpm || true; cat /tmp/laradock-apache-logs/error.log || true; docker rm -f apache-smoke php-fpm || true; docker network rm laradock-apache-smoke || true' EXIT
          docker run -d --name php-fpm --network laradock-apache-smoke \
            -v /tmp/laradock-apache-www:/var/www php:8.3-fpm-alpine
          docker run -d --name apache-smoke --network laradock-apache-smoke \
            -p 127.0.0.1:18080:80 -p 127.0.0.1:18443:443 \
            -v /tmp/laradock-apache-www:/var/www \
            -v /tmp/laradock-apache-logs:/var/log/apache2 \
            -v /tmp/laradock-apache-sites:/etc/apache2/sites-available:ro \
            -v /tmp/laradock-apache-ssl:/etc/apache2/ssl \
            laradock-apache-smoke
          if [ "$HTTP2" = true ]; then
            curl --fail --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 --noproxy '*' --insecure --http2 --resolve laradock.test:18443:127.0.0.1 https://laradock.test:18443/ | grep -F apache-smoke
            curl --fail --noproxy '*' --insecure --http2 --resolve laradock.test:18443:127.0.0.1 https://laradock.test:18443/smoke.php | grep -Fx php-smoke
            [ "$(curl --silent --noproxy '*' --insecure --http2 --resolve laradock.test:18443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_version}' https://laradock.test:18443/)" = 2 ]
          else
            curl --fail --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 -H 'Host: laradock.test' http://127.0.0.1:18080/ | grep -F apache-smoke
            curl --fail -H 'Host: laradock.test' http://127.0.0.1:18080/smoke.php | grep -Fx php-smoke
          fi

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
